text: The purpose of this report is to make changes to the Mount Pleasant Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management, in accordance with the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. Mount Pleasant Village Business Improvement Areas falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on April 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council remove the following director from the Mount Pleasant Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below. Heller, Gregory (Greg)
